g.text: Ours: what Orchestra owns and runs
Interface: where work crosses, and my outbox

g.title: Someone asks me to run a command on a bastion. Adopted prevention lowers how often these requests come at all: the long balancing loop. — crosses: slack/jira in
Find runbooks; explain what the command does, its impact and risks — crosses: read: runbooks, code, docs
Verify the chain of authority for a production change — crosses: read: jira approvals, change tickets, org chart
Verify the chain of authority for a production change — crosses: read: jira approvals, change tickets, org chart

Root cause and context: customer ticket? unsafe ramp? rollout follow-up? repeats elsewhere?. Simplification: a fifth of requests need a repeat in other environments; the split moves that share into follow-ups rather than duplicating the request. — crosses: read: customer jira, flag history, deploys, release calendars

Root cause and context: customer ticket? unsafe ramp? rollout follow-up? repeats elsewhere?. Simplification: a fifth of requests need a repeat in other environments; the split moves that share into follow-ups rather than duplicating the request. — crosses: read: customer jira, flag history, deploys, release calendars
Read the brief and decide (me)
Read the brief and decide (me)
Run the command (me only, never an agent) — crosses: bastion host (human only)
Log what happened and why, where the company will see it — crosses: jira/slack write (via outbox)
File follow-up tickets for the other environments — crosses: jira write (via outbox)
Look for a pattern across requests worth preventing
Look for a pattern across requests worth preventing
Turn a problem statement into a proposal (me edits, agent drafts) — crosses: docs write; slack post for review
Company reviews and adopts the prevention. About two working weeks from proposal to adoption, when it is adopted at all.
Requests to run a production command
Command explained: runbooks, impact, risks
Chain of authority verified
Context ready: customer ticket, unsafe ramp, rollout follow-up, other environments
Decided to run, waiting for me to run it
Declined or redirected
Ran; being logged
Manual repeats needed in government and monthly environments
Follow-up tickets filed
Logged; candidate for prevention
No pattern worth acting on
Problem statements drafted from patterns
Problem statements and proposals in company review
Prevention adopted: policy or automation
